form.$description: Form's component tokens, for Form and FormSteps. Each one is an optional override: set the CSS variable (--form-<name>) on the page, a container or one Form, and every Form inside follows. Unset, it uses the shared token it references here; tools/test/foundation.mjs checks that bundle.css uses exactly these defaults.

focus-ring.$description: The ring around a step's heading when it has focus from the keyboard.

gap.$description: Space between the form's parts: the summary, each field, the buttons (24px).

actions-gap.$description: Space between FormSteps' Next (or submit) and Back buttons (12px).

steps-gap.$description: Space between FormSteps' progress bar, the step and its buttons (32px).

step-title-weight.$description: The weight of each step's heading.
